# Finalyse

> Finalyse delivers risk advisory, valuation, and compliance solutions for banking, insurance, and pension fund institutions navigating complex regulatory frameworks.

Finalyse is a specialized financial services firm offering expertise across risk management, regulatory compliance, actuarial services, and asset valuation. The company serves financial institutions across Europe with deep knowledge of frameworks like Solvency II, IFRS 17, EMIR, and SFTR.

## Key Topics

- Solvency II
- IFRS 17
- Risk Management
- Regulatory Compliance
- Banking Services
- Insurance Services
- Actuarial Services
- Climate Risk Assessment
- EMIR & SFTR Reporting
- Credit Risk
- Capital Management
- Asset Valuation
- ECL Framework
- Stress Testing
- Financial Institutions

## Core Services

- [Finalyse: A Fresh Take on Risk and Valuation](https://www.finalyse.com): Finalyse homepage: risk, valuation & compliance solutions for financial institutions
- [Finalyse: Risk Advisory Services for Banking](https://www.finalyse.com/banking): Banking risk advisory services: capital management, credit risk, compliance
- [Finalyse: Risk Advisory and Actuarial Services for Insurance and Pension Funds](https://www.finalyse.com/insurance-and-pension-funds): Insurance and pension actuarial services: Solvency II, IFRS 17 compliance
- [Finalyse: Valuation & Managed Services](https://www.finalyse.com/valuation-managed-services): Asset valuation and managed services for buy-side and sell-side clients
